text:
deploy-bot: deploy-check FAILED — service=inference-api, check=env-parity, reason=INFERENCE_CACHE_S3_PREFIX mismatch between staging and prod. Release blocked. runbook: https://internal.runbooks/release-check

alex: saw this, thanks. staging = s3://redwood-inference-dev/cache-v2, prod = s3://redwood-inference/cache

jamie: omg :grimacing: when did that change? Release window starts in 30m

priyanka: I think an infra normalization script ran last week but only targeted staging namespaces. Reproducer: `kubectl -n inference-api get configmap env -o yaml | yq .data.INFERENCE_CACHE_S3_PREFIX`

ryan: also saw model-variant fallback in prod canary logs: `WARN model_router: cache lookup failed for prefix 's3://redwood-inference-dev'` — produced elevated latency and a few 503s

maya: customer-facing risk — embeddings cache misses will regen lots of tokens. Could cause spikes in cost and UX regressions

alex: options: A) backfill prod configmap to match staging prefix (priyanka) B) pin release to a compat model variant `cache-compat-v1` until we fix (jamie) C) rollback current canary if it's already harmful (ryan)

jamie: recommend backfill + small canary. Need SRE sign-off on backfill script and security review on S3 ACLs

priyanka: prepping backfill job: `python infra/scripts/backfill_cache_prefix.py --env prod --from s3://redwood-inference-dev/cache-v2 --to INFERENCE_CACHE_S3_PREFIX` will dry-run in staging first

ryan: I'll standby and add temporary alerts (error-rate, 95p latency). Abort if >2x baseline or sustained 5xx increase

alex: timeline: dry-run in 10m, if green apply to prod in change window at +45m. jamie please update release notes to reflect env parity fix and potential short delay

jamie: will update release notes & notify customers on delay. Creating follow-up Jira INF-3421

priyanka: created PR #4898 for backfill, added unit tests, tagging ops. Will link once CI is green

deploy-bot: note: deploy schedule paused; release-window=2026-03-21T16:00Z -> paused until manual unpause

maya: thanks team. If we see any S3 ACL concerns during audit, fallback to option B (pin variant)

alex: consensus: attempt backfill + canary. If backfill audit surfaces ACL mismatch, fallback to model pin. Owners: priyanka, ryan, jamie

jamie: assigning actions: priyanka -> backfill PR & run (10m), ryan -> monitor & abort criteria, jamie -> release note update & customer comms, alex -> final go/no-go

ryan: I'll open an incident channel if abort needed :rotating_light:

priyanka: dry-run complete in staging, no ACL diffs observed. Proceeding to prod backfill in 5m

deploy-bot: ACTION: prod-configmap updated for inference-api INFERENCE_CACHE_S3_PREFIX -> s3://redwood-inference/cache-v2 by infra/backfill-job-4550123456

ryan: canary looks stable after 2m: error rate normal, 95p latency within baseline. Holding for 15m

jamie: release window resumed, tagging release notes with backfill change and removing temporary model pin

alex: closing thread — thanks all. Follow-up ticket INF-3421 created for post-mortem and to automate parity checks (periodic preflight).
